interpretation: The hard fallback policy improves held-out mean, block and variance fidelity, but its exact-area execution cost outweighs those gains under the preregistered development objective.
The selected threshold is stable and all sealed safety/statistical gates pass, yet it is 7.44% worse than the simpler global P4H baseline on the only split allowed to select policy.
Threshold routing therefore closes without relaxing the objective or adding router capacity. Exact-area remains an offline reference and P4H remains stationary-only.
